declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleFormInput

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The placeholder, shown while the value is empty. Reflected.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: The autofill hint, passed to the field. Reflected.

members.name: inputMode
members.description:
The virtual keyboard hint (attribute `inputmode`), passed to the field. Reflected. Its TypeScript type is the
`string` of `HTMLElement.inputMode`, which it overrides; absent, it reads `undefined`.

members.name: pattern
members.description: The pattern the value must match, as the native constraint. Reflected.

members.name: min
members.description: The minimum of a `number` field, as the native constraint. Reflected.

members.name: max
members.description: The maximum of a `number` field, as the native constraint. Reflected.

members.name: step
members.description: The step of a `number` field, as the native constraint and for ArrowUp and ArrowDown. Reflected.

members.name: minLength
members.description: The minimum length of the value (attribute `minlength`), as the native constraint; absent, no limit. Reflected.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: The maximum length of the value (attribute `maxlength`), as the native constraint; absent, no limit. Reflected.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Whether the value can be focused and submitted but not edited (attribute `readonly`). Reflected.

members.name: type
members.description:
The field's type: `text`, `email`, `url`, `tel`, `search`, `password` or `number`; any other value behaves as `text`
and the property reads `"text"`, while the attribute keeps the value as written. Reflected.

members.name: name
members.description: The name the value is submitted under; without one the value is not in the form data. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description: The visible label, drawn above the control; it names the control after any external `<label>`. Reflected.

members.name: description
members.description: The description, drawn under the label and the control's accessible description. Reflected.

members.name: error
members.description:
The error the host sets: shown under the control, it marks the control invalid for assistive technology, is added
to its description and is announced politely once each time it changes to a new text; it does not block
submission. Whitespace is collapsed and trimmed. Reflected.

members.name: required
members.description: Whether a value is required, as the native constraint. Reflected.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Whether the control is disabled: not focusable, not editable and not in the form data. Reflected.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value: what the user typed or chose, or what a script, a reset or a restore set. Not reflected.

members.name: form
members.description: The form the control belongs to, or null, as a native control's.

members.name: labels
members.description: The `<label>` elements associated with the control, as a native control's.

members.name: validity
members.description: The control's validity, the native control's constraint validation.

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: The browser's validation message for the native control, or empty when it is valid.

members.name: willValidate
members.description: Whether the control takes part in constraint validation.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Whether the control satisfies its constraints; when not, it fires `invalid` at the host.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: As `checkValidity()`, and when invalid the browser focuses the native control and shows its message.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the native control; the host is not a tab stop of its own.

events.name: ocelle-form-input-change
events.description: A committed change of the value by the user (the field left after a change, or Enter), with the value; never for a change by script, reset or restore.

declarations.description:
A labelled text field with an optional description and a host-set error, that takes part in its form like a native
input: its value is submitted under `name`, validated by the browser's own constraints, restored on reset and on
history restore, and disabled by a disabled fieldset.

declarations.name: OcelleNotice

members.name: tone
members.description:
The tone: `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `neutral`; any other value behaves as `info` and the property
reads `"info"`, while the attribute keeps the value as written. Reflected.

members.name: size
members.description:
The size: `regular` or `compact`; any other value behaves as `regular` and the property reads `"regular"`, while
the attribute keeps the value as written. Reflected.

members.name: announce
members.description:
Whether the notice announces its text once on insertion after parsing, on reveal and on each change, politely
for `info`, `success` and `neutral` and assertively for `warning` and `danger`. Reflected.

declarations.description:
A message about a state or result in a box whose look follows its tone, with an optional heading, in the regular or
the compact size, announced once by assistive technology when `announce` is set.

cssParts.name: heading
cssParts.description: The heading's box, not drawn when the heading is absent.
